learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge regarding quality assurance of welded structures from manufacturing to component acceptance.
Applications of steel construction and manufacturing of products in regulated and unregulated areas.
Qualification of welding processes/welded structures as well as the opportunities and risks in the fusion welding processing of old steels up to modern high-strength steels.
Understanding of the most important welding-related quality requirements.
Development of solutions for problems in quality assurance of welded constructions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to quality assurance of welded structures
Requirements and qualification for welding processes / welding procedure tests
Welding-related quality requirements according to DIN EN ISO 3834
Non-destructive testing (VT, MT, PT, RT, UT, ET) on welded joints
Welding of old steels in repair work
Flame straightening of high-strength water-quenched fine-grain structural steels and their metallurgical behavior during the flame straightening process
Introduction to new topics and critical questioning
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the examination. Successful participation in the practical course is a prerequisite for taking the examination.
